title: Import parties
dropHint: A .csv, .xlsx or .xls file with one party per row. Exports from Vyapar, Marg, Tally or Excel work.
requiredHint: Required: pick the column with party names

defaultHint.type: Everyone is added as a customer
defaultHint.state: Taken from the GSTIN, or your own state

ifExists: If a party with the same name exists:
updateBalance: Also change the balance of existing parties (their balances move with every credit bill)
notImported: Errors and skipped rows are not imported.
failed: The import did not go through. Nothing was saved.

row.stateMissing: No state in the file. Choose a state for rows without one above the list, or add it to the file

warn.type: Type "{{value}}" not understood: added as customer
warn.gstin: GSTIN "{{value}}" is not valid: left blank
warn.gstinCheck: GSTIN "{{value}}": the check digit does not match. Please verify
warn.stateFromGstin: The GSTIN says {{state}}: that state is used
warn.stateDefault: No state in the file: set to {{state}}
warn.phoneLong: Phone "{{value}}" is longer than 20 characters: shortened
warn.addressLong: Address is longer than 300 characters: shortened
warn.balance: Balance "{{value}}" is not a number: left at zero
warn.balanceKept: Balance in the file ignored: existing balance kept
